Bill.BriefDescription: Encouraging institutions of higher education to conduct comprehensive reviews of admission applicants.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to encouraging institutions of higher education toconduct comprehensive reviews of admission applications; and creatingnew sections.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature recognizes that the presenceof a diverse learning environment helps students acquire the skillsneeded to live and work successfully in our increasingly diversesociety. The United States supreme court and the Washington supremecourt have recognized the benefits of such educational diversity in astudent body as a compelling state interest as long as the meansemployed to promote diversity are within narrowly tailored guidelinesthat ensure that individuals are not unduly impacted. To ensure thehighest quality of education is provided at our universities andcolleges, they must have the ability to engage in a comprehensivereview of each applicant that includes all the positive qualities andexperiences an applicant possesses.

The boards of regents and boards of trustees p. 1 SSB 6073at research and comprehensive higher education institutions areencouraged to establish policies on diversity in admissions and toconduct comprehensive reviews of every application for admission.
